name: FAQ · shop orders
description: Warm peach background with left-hand circle icons.

items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 working days. Express orders placed before 2pm arrive the next day.

items.question: Is shipping free?
items.answer: Orders over $60 ship free within the country. Otherwise a flat $5.90 fee applies.

items.question: Can I return something I have worn?
items.answer: Unworn items with tags can be returned within 30 days for a full refund. Worn items can be exchanged if faulty.

items.question: Do you ship internationally?
items.answer: We ship to 28 countries. Duties and taxes are shown at checkout so there are no surprises on delivery.

items.question: How do I track my parcel?
items.answer: You will get an email with a tracking link as soon as your order leaves the warehouse.
